software.heading: Software versions:
software.dashboard: Web dashboard (package installed; runtime not confirmed)
language.changed: Language settings saved. New turns and future system messages use the updated preferences; active turns remain unchanged.
language.invalid: Invalid language setting. Use a BCP-47 tag such as en, de, es, ru or en-GB.
lifecycle.restarting: ♻️ Restarting: new input is fenced; current work is checkpointed for recovery (default deadline 60s).
mcp.help:
MCP management (no model turn):
/mcp — status, or interactive manager in the local TUI
/mcp add <name> <http-url> | -- <executable> [quoted args] | <JSON server configuration>
/mcp edit <name> <JSON server configuration>
/mcp remove <name>
/mcp connect|reconnect|disconnect <name>
/mcp enable|disable [name] — all MCP or one server
/mcp tools <name>
/mcp exposure <name> direct|codemode|deferred|hidden
/mcp login|logout <name>
/mcp auth <server-name|login-id> <browser-redirect-url>
/mcp cancel <server-name|login-id>
/mcp help
HTTP and stdio are supported. Use environment references for credentials, not chat messages.
mcp.unavailable: MCP management is unavailable in this runtime
mcp.failure: MCP operation failed. Check the server name/configuration and /mcp status. Credential and callback details are withheld. /mcp help lists commands.
mcp.authComplete: MCP {name}: signed in; {count} tools. Login {id}: complete.
mcp.authFailed: MCP {name}: sign-in {state}. Login {id}. No credential or callback details are echoed.
mcp.configInvalid: MCP configuration is invalid; repair mcp.json (values withheld)
mcp.collision: MCP server name collides with an existing server
mcp.extension: This server is registered by an extension; change that extension's configuration
mcp.enableFirst: Enable this MCP server before signing in
mcp.multiple: Multiple MCP sign-ins match; use the login ID
mcp.loginNotFound: MCP login not found for this operator and conversation
mcp.notPending: MCP login is no longer pending
mcp.notWaiting: MCP login is not waiting for a browser redirect
mcp.loopback: Expected the browser's loopback redirect URL
mcp.changed: Server configuration changed; start sign-in again
mcp.unclosedQuote: Unclosed quote or escape in MCP arguments
mcp.loginInProgress: A sign-in for this server is already in progress
mcp.loginStarted: MCP {name}: sign-in started. Login {id}. Authorization link and result will appear here.
mcp.redirectReceived: MCP browser redirect received; sign-in result will appear here
mcp.globalChanged: MCP {state}; session connections update at the next turn boundary
mcp.saved: MCP {name}: configuration saved; {state}. /mcp status {name}; /mcp login {name} for OAuth.
mcp.serverDisabled: MCP {name}: disabled; existing session connections close at their next turn boundary
mcp.arguments: Arguments (quote arguments containing spaces; may be empty)
language.listing: Show/set default, system, background, conversation or per-MCP language (BCP-47)
conversation.reset: 🆕 Fresh conversation context. Previous conversation tasks, continuations and child executions were stopped; conversation loops, heartbeat and goal were cleared. Other conversations and independent scheduled jobs are unchanged.
